RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Colony haste
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 12% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Utopia builders
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 20% global work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Gifted minds
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 50% global learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Abundant fields
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 30% plant work speed and 30% harvest yield per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Industrial lifeblood
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 45% mining speed and 30% mining yield per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Peace of mind
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack lowers all colonists' mental break threshold by 4 percentage points, subject to the game's minimum.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Research breakthrough
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 90% research speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Sleepless colony
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Rest consumption is divided by (1 + 1 × stacks). Adds 20% work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Steel tide
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Delivers 100 steel per stack each day near a colonist. No production facilities required. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Silver from nothing
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Provides 120 silver per stack each day. The added wealth still affects ordinary raid scaling. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Medical reserve
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Provides 3 medicine each day and adds 60% immunity gain speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Dice factory
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack adds 1 shared rerolls to drafts begun afterward. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Colony overclock
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 30% damage against enemies, 30% health and 30% global work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Resonant storm
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 0.65 chain level and 15.925% damage against enemies per stack. Every 3 valid direct hits against standing enemies, each colonist releases lightning from the struck target to other standing enemies. Default radius: 16 cells; adjustable from 8–32. Hits up to 2 + rounded-up total chain level targets, capped at 12. Ordinary neutral animals do not trigger it. Draft limit: 8 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Prismatic treasury
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Provides 24 gold per stack each day. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Blood pact
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: All colonists gain 10% direct-damage lifesteal and heal 0.3 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack. Healing does not restore missing body parts. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fleet-footed
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 35% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Jeweled Gauntlet
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants 25% critical value and allows ability damage to critically strike. Critical value above 100% increases critical damage. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Immovable
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 30% health per stack. Damage taken is divided by (1 + 0.35 × stacks). Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Second wind
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Heals 1.2 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack, applied about every 4.2 seconds. Does not repair permanent scars or missing body parts. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Heartsteel
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 25% health per stack. Hitting a standing enemy grants 0.65 permanent steel mark per stack, once every 2 seconds. Each mark adds another 3% health. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fervor of battle
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Valid hits build a combo, lost after 10 seconds without a hit. Each combo hit adds 0.065 per stack to melee and ranged cooldown divisors; each stack also adds 0.2275 to the base divisors. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Blood feast
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Heals ordinary injuries for 25% of direct damage dealt to enemies per stack. Stacks with Blood pact and Bloodforged armor. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Endless feast
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 25% health per stack. A full contribution share grants 0.65 permanent feast stack per card stack. The killing blow still heals 7.8 injury points per card stack. Each feast stack adds 4% health and 3% damage against enemies. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Trigger overload
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 25% damage against enemies per stack. Ranged cooldown is divided by (1 + 0.7 × stacks); aiming time and burst intervals are unchanged. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Terminator
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack adds 25% direct damage and 7.5 percentage points to the execution threshold, capped at 65%. Hits below the threshold deal massive secondary damage.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Thunderlord
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 1.3 chain levels and 30% damage against enemies per stack, combining with Runecarver and Resonant storm. Every 3 valid direct hits against standing enemies releases lightning to others around the target. Default radius: 16 cells; adjustable from 8–32. Hits up to 2 + rounded-up total chain level other enemies, capped at 12. Ordinary neutral animals do not trigger it. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Art of destruction
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 1.3 detonation levels per stack. Every 4 valid hits causes an enemy-only blast within 4.5 cells of the target. Stacks with Detonation orb. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Colossus
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 120% health, 20% movement speed and 0.6 to the damage-taken divisor per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: One-person army
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 90% damage against enemies, 70% health and 20% lifesteal per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Fortune's favor
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack adds 60% critical value and 40% direct damage. Critical value above 100% increases critical damage.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Path to ascension
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Adds 75% damage against enemies and 75% health, and heals 1.8 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.
